title: Wild Chimps Sharpen Sticks Into Spears With Their Teeth

scenes.text: Wild chimpanzees make spears, and they hunt with them.
In Senegal, researchers watched them break off branches and strip the bark.
Then they sharpen the tips with their teeth.
They jab the spears into tree hollows where bushbabies sleep.
Scientists recorded 22 spear hunts. Most were by young chimps, including females.
Only one hunt worked, but they kept making spears.
